tasks.title: Conversation #79
tasks.transcript:
Woman: I heard you join the campus chess club. How's it going?
Man: Great! I'm learning a lot and meeting new people.
Woman: I've always wanted to learn to play, but I've never tried. Is everyone pretty advanced?
Man: No, not necessarily. There are members of all skill levels and everyone's very supportive. Woman: When do they meet?
Man: Every Saturday afternoon at the student center.
Woman: Okay, I usually work at the library then, but they're very flexible, so I'm sure I could make it work.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the Chess Club?

options.A: It is run by the man.
options.B: It requires a small fee to join.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目的意思是：关于国际象棋俱乐部可以推断出什么？ 选项分析： A. It is run by the man. 男士只是会员，未提及他是负责人。 B. It requires a small fee to join. 对话中未提及费用问题。 C. It accepts beginners. 女士担心自己不会玩，男士回答“No, not necessarily. There are members of all skill levels”（不全是，有各种水平的会员），这说明俱乐部接受并欢迎初学者，符合题意。 D. It has very few members. 文中未提及会员数量少。

questions.stem: Based on the conversation, what will the woman most likely do?

options.C: Help the man get a job at the library

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目的意思是：根据对话，女士接下来最可能做什么？ 选项分析： A. Change her schedule. 女士提到周六下午通常要在图书馆工作，但紧接着说“they’re very flexible, so I’m sure I could make it work”（他们很灵活，所以我确信我能协调好）。这暗示她将调整自己的日程安排以便参加俱乐部活动，符合题意。 B. Volunteer with the man. 未提及志愿服务。 C. Help the man get a job at the library. 未提及帮男士找工作。 D. Return a library book. 提到图书馆只是说她工作的地方，与还书无关。
